following:
ORDER Case diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.

This is first bail application u/S.439 of the Cr.P.C.
filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

T h e applicant has been arrested on 21.02.2024 by Police Station- Barwah, District Khargone in connection with Crime No.551/2023, registered in relation to the offence punishable under section 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(N) of IPC and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
As per prosecution case, on 18/09/2023 father of the prosecutrix lodged the missing report and F.I.R. on 02/10/2023.
During the investigation the prosecutrix has been recovered on 14/12/2023 and her MLC has been done.

Her statements u/s 161 & 164 of Cr.P.C. were recorded and after that applicant has been implicated and applicant has been arrested by the police.

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.

The applicant and the prosecutrix were in love relationship with each other and she went alongwith the applicant from her home to Maharastra and did not raise any alarm anywhere and stayed with him for more than one month.
He is in custody since 21.02.2024.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.
The applicant is permanent resident of Khargone and there is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
He is ready to abide by the terms and conditions as may be imposed.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made out.

Learned counsel for the State opposed the application contending that the the prosecutrix is minor aged about 16 years and specific allegation has been made by the prosecutrix against the applicant,
no case for grant of bail is made out and prays for rejection of bail application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case coupled with the fact that the trial is not likely to conclude in near future and prolonged pre- trial detention being an anathema to the concept of liberty, this Court is inclined to extend the benefit of bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with one local surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial 3 MCRC-23541-2024 Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
